description: This script generates various name constraints and subject alternative names for testing certificate validation, including functions for encoding names, generating constraints, and creating test data files.

classes.name: SubjectAltNameGenerator
classes.description: Class for building and representing Subject Alternative Names in ASN.1 format.

classes.name: NameConstraintsGenerator
classes.description: Class for constructing name constraints with permitted and excluded subtrees.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a certificate extension file with encoded name constraints or SANs.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Returns the token string for the generator classes.

methods.name: add_name
methods.description: Adds a general name to the SubjectAltNameGenerator.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns ASN.1 string representation of the name or constraints.

methods.name: union_from
methods.description: Combines permitted and excluded subtrees from another constraints object.

methods.name: add_permitted
methods.description: Adds a permitted general name to the constraints.

methods.name: add_excluded
methods.description: Adds an excluded general name to the constraints.
